briefing: NASDAQ +1.6% and S&P 500 +0.7% mark a moderate risk-on day, but with only $389.29 in cash — below the $500 deployment threshold — and no candidate meeting the four-signal high-conviction bar for a partial position, we held all 7 positions and kept cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today's market gain was positive but not strong enough (NASDAQ under +2%) and available cash was below the $500 minimum needed for a new position, so holding cash was the disciplined choice rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是保留在場邊、等待絕佳時機才投入的現金。今日雖然大盤上漲，但漲幅未達強力風多訊號（納指未超過2%），且可用現金低於建倉所需的500美元門檻，因此按兵不動、保留現金才是紀律嚴謹的做法，而非勉強進場交易。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices advanced today, led by the NASDAQ's 1.6% gain versus the S&P 500's more modest 0.7% rise, suggesting growth and tech names outperformed value-oriented sectors. No major company-specific catalysts were flagged in today's data feed. The relative strength of the NASDAQ points to continued investor appetite for higher-beta names in a risk-on tape.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍上揚，納斯達克指數上漲1.6%，領先標普500指數0.7%的漲幅，顯示成長股與科技股表現優於價值型類股。今日數據並未標示出特定公司層面的重大消息。納指相對強勢，反映市場對高貝塔成長股的風險偏好持續升溫。
